source_message:
feat(compliance): add policy_scope to AMLResult and BanxeAMLResult

- models.py: AMLResult.policy_scope: dict[str, str] with default
  {policy_jurisdiction, policy_regulator, policy_framework}; **self.policy_scope
  in to_audit_dict() → ClickHouse gets all three provenance columns
- banxe_aml_orchestrator.py: BanxeAMLResult.policy_scope mirroring POLICY_*
  constants; populated in banxe_assess() and expanded in to_audit_dict()

Closes the last mile: policy provenance now flows
compliance_validator → orchestrator → AMLResult → ClickHouse audit_trail.
Per ADR-008: single policy_scope contract across the full stack.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>
